evaluation_target.statement: Evaluate whether the system prevents unintended braking.
evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal explicitly states that the system shall prevent unintended braking, and the hazard defines the adverse event as the vehicle suddenly stopping without an obstacle in front.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Vehicle braking behavior in the operational situation where the ego vehicle drives straight ahead on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front and in good weather conditions.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: States and events of the driving situation described in the hazard, including whether braking occurs unexpectedly in the absence of a relevant forward obstacle.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The hazard specifies the operational situation and the hazardous event that characterizes the phenomenon to be evaluated.

distinctions.dimension: Braking occurrence in the stated operational situation
distinctions.contrast_a: The vehicle brakes or stops unexpectedly while no obstacle is in front of the vehicle
distinctions.contrast_b: The vehicle does not brake unexpectedly in the same situation
distinctions.rationale: If these cases were indistinguishable, it would be impossible to evaluate whether unintended braking occurred, which is the core of the safety goal.

distinctions.dimension: Presence of a relevant forward obstacle in the stated operational situation
distinctions.contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle
distinctions.contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle
distinctions.rationale: The hazard defines unintended braking by the absence of an obstacle; preserving this distinction is necessary to judge whether braking is intended as collision avoidance or is unintended.

orrs.obligation: An Observable Representation must preserve whether the vehicle performed an unexpected braking or stopping event in the declared operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must allow one to distinguish unexpected braking/stopping from no unexpected braking/stopping within the same operational situation.

orrs.obligation: An Observable Representation must preserve whether a relevant obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the declared operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must allow one to distinguish presence of a forward obstacle from absence of a forward obstacle.
